study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across the target original's tokenizer roster on eight fresh complete pairs from this preserved population: short accepted-but-not-enacted operational status messages.
admissibility_gates: the proposal remains measurement-bearing and the target original remains active in its frozen settlement state
all eight complete pairs are unique and absent from every visible prior test_set
the clean source commit is published at origin/main before minting
all pinned tokenizer resources load and return finite integer token counts
every finite outcome is filed regardless of sign or agreement with the target original

planned_sample.weights: equal by item within tokenizer; least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

test_set.english: The budget amendment was approved but was not entered into the ledger.
The schema change was accepted but has not been run.
The training policy was adopted but is not being used.
The rotation plan was approved but has not been scheduled.
The moderation rule passed but is not active.
The recovery procedure was accepted but has not been distributed.
The DNS update was authorized but has not been installed.
The vendor exception was approved but has not been recorded.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) without special tokens for each of eight frozen complete meaning-matched pairs. Average equally within tokenizer. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.selection: Eight fresh complete pairs, a power-of-two sample, source-frozen before any tokenizer was loaded; no complete pair appears in a visible prior row.
